title: Elux Legend Blueberry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend Blueberry Nic Salt captures the sweet, full-bodied taste of ripe Blueberries in a smooth and satisfying vape. The flavour is rich and rounded, delivering a mellow berry character with gentle tart undertones that add depth without overwhelming the blend. As part of the Elux Legend Nic Salt collection, this e-liquid is crafted with double-concentrated flavouring to deliver the vivid, fruit-driven taste Elux is known for. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, Blueberry Nic Salt is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices. Its smooth nicotine salt formula ensures discreet vapour, rich flavour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths.
